spec.title: validate-xml script seems to validate all XML files, not just the one(s) in question
spec.context: The validate-xml script currently ignores any command-line arguments and always validates all XML files in .kanban/tasks/. This prevents targeted validation during development and makes the script inefficient for pre-commit hooks or iterative workflows where only specific task files need checking.

scope.in-scope: - Add task ID argument parsing to validate-xml.ts - Validate only XML files in specified task folder when ID provided - Maintain fallback to all-files validation when no argument - Update skill-complete.md partial to pass {taskId}
scope.out-of-scope: - Schema validation (only syntax validation) - Multiple task ID arguments (single task or all) - File path arguments (use task ID pattern)

spec.requirements: - FR1: The script shall accept an optional task ID as the first positional argument - FR2: When a task ID is provided, the script shall only validate XML files in .kanban/tasks/{taskId}/ - FR3: When no arguments are provided, the script shall validate all XML files in .kanban/tasks/ (current behavior) - FR4: The script shall return an error in JSON if the specified task folder does not exist - FR5: The skill-complete partial shall include {taskId} in the validate-xml command

files.file: Add argument parsing and conditional file collection

patterns.pattern: Use process.argv.slice(2) for positional arguments Reference: apps/kanban/src/scripts/find-task.ts:22
Resolve task ID to path: .kanban/tasks/{taskId}/ Reference: apps/kanban/src/scripts/find-task.ts:24-30
Return { valid, filesChecked, errors } structure Reference: apps/kanban/src/scripts/validate-xml.ts:18-22

research.product: - validation/xml: Documents current all-files behavior, notes "no incremental" as limitation
research.engineering: - systems/cli: CLI scripts use process.argv.slice(2) for arguments, return JSON - patterns/tagged-union-errors: Scripts return { error: true, message } or success structure
research.codebase: - validate-xml.ts: main() calls getAllXmlFiles() unconditionally at line 70 - validateFile(): Existing function validates single file, reusable as-is - getAllXmlFiles(): Collects all XML files, becomes fallback when no args - skill-complete.md: Single partial included by 18+ skills, centralizes validation call

spec.constraints: - Must maintain backward compatibility (no args = validate all) - Must follow existing CLI script patterns (JSON output, process.argv) - Must work on Windows (path normalization)

risks.risk: Skills without taskId context would need to omit argument
